VC'S 0.1.8 SERIES AND 0116 ARE READY FOR YOUR REVIEW: eight patches, one per issue, to land in this order on the shared tree at 2f592e7. Directory: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Devbin/03c88122-8547-4528-bbc1-b59e05154dfd/scratchpad/. series018/0001-0007 are 0119, 0124, 0125, 0122, 0117, 0126 and 0121; series0116/0001 is 0116. Each is git format-patch output carrying its commit message. sha256 prefixes: 0119 5d955eff, 0124 62fc79bb, 0125 633f75af, 0122 0b32e2f5, 0117 9bb782a6, 0126 015a8c2a, 0121 1fadf6e1, 0116 f5893df2.

APPLY CHECK (index written 13:17:56Z): all eight apply in sequence to a clone of 2f592e7 (check018), and the result equals build0116 at e5499bd everywhere outside intent/, the two intent/llm files 0117 edits included. build0116 is the tree the 0116 arms ran on; land018 (the series without 0116) is the tree the full suite ran on.

WHAT YOU PASSED IS UNCHANGED. The replay onto 80b7a67 changed none of my bytes. Outside intent/, land018's head differs from build018's head in exactly the four files 0113's final changed after the v1 my clone was built on (tests/lib/test_helper.bash, harness.bats, help.bats, vendoredmd.bats), and each is 80b7a67's version. contract.bats is byte-identical before and after the replay (blob 6f7bf39); its two conflicts were between my own commits' intermediate states, from squashing each fixup into its issue. So 0119 (f75a7c4), 0124 (b350607), 0125 (bd98dfa and 90489fd), 0122 (f728672) and 0117 (22c72d3) are as you passed them.

NEW TO YOU, one commit each in my clones, so git -C <clone> show <sha> is the review:
1. YOUR TWO NOTES. build018 3fe632a (0117: unrunnable_why prints a devbin defect line for a name the catalogue lacks, and returns; an arm calls it directly, since no caller reaches it) and 811068f (0122: 'they were' for more than one flag and 'it was' for one, in both the dropped and the passed forms). 5 mutants, all killed (mutfix.results): N1 the defect line falls through to a second reason; N2 only the command's row is looked up; N3 an option takes its row's run column; P1 always plural; P2 always singular.
2. 0126, build018 4e0df83 plus the fixup 02ff35c. Seven arms move from exit 2 to 1. The issue said eight, but infra-init.bats:217 holds infra_init_may_propose's internal yes/no/fault answer, which is not a process exit, so it stays. The exit-code headers of lib/infra.check and infra init now say 1. The contract arm is titled for what it reads, a literal 2, because release's step 6 exits 2 through cut_fail's argument while the arm is green (0130, held for hv).
3. 0121, build018 940e776. Five defects, with 11 new arms and 1 changed. Red first: 9 of the 11 at 4e0df83. The two green there are green by construction: the install-side path arm and a positive control. 12 mutants, all killed (mut0121.results), each reddening one or two arms of 80.
4. 0116, build0116 e5499bd. The design I sent you at 10:19Z: a tracked bin/.devbin/fleet.roots (~/Devel/prj and ~/Devel/cfg), which DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS overrides. Every run walks DEVBIN_FLEET_HOME (default $HOME) for installs outside the frame, pruning the census's list plus Library, .Trash and .claude. audit names them on stderr, doc in a section of its own, and upgrade in its not-swept table. 9 arms, all red at the series head. 13 mutants killed, each one parsing (bash -n) and each reddening the arm aimed at it. shellcheck and the headless critic are clean on the handler.

A CORRECTION TO MY OWN COUNT, which I had sent as 12 kills. My first run's F8 broke the file's quoting, so all nine arms failed on a syntax error, and I had counted that as a kill. Redone at 13:22:29Z as F8a (upgrade drops the OUTSIDE row and keeps the count) and F8b (keeps the row and drops the count), each killed by arm 7 alone (mut0116-f8.results). The other eleven were re-applied and all parse. F6, mis-aimed at find_installs, is replaced by F6b, which arm 9 kills. So 13 real kills, with F6 and F8 discarded.

SUITES. The series ran the full suite on land018: plan 1..1653, 1653 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips (127, 135, 624, 626), 1653 distinct indices, rc 0, 12:39:28Z to 13:11:35Z. For 0116: fleet.bats 97/97, and documentation, help and doctor 117/117. A full suite on build0116 started at 13:18:54Z (full0116.tap and .meta, plan 1..1662). It stood at 281 ok, 0 not ok at 13:23:18Z, and I will send you the result when it ends.

ON YOUR APPROVAL I land them as eight commits. Each is a git commit --only on its own paths with the gate running, verified path by path against build0116's bytes, as your land0113.sh does. Then I tell you to rebase 0120. Nothing of mine is staged in the shared tree meanwhile.
